source_uncertainty.statement: It is unresolved whether the newly persistent P3 step/junction/platform organization is structurally compatible with the persistent P4 stair/terrace organization.
source_uncertainty.selection_note: P4 is the minimal justified counterpart because obs_p4_stair and obs_p4_terrace are separate persistent LocalObservation entries with exact ROIs. P5 has useful 788 stair/platform-sector evidence only inside broad obs_p5_side_wall, not separate persistent stair/platform LocalObservation entries; 792 already exhausted lower-volume/opening containment/order. The P3 wall candidate from 794 remains WITHHELD and is excluded.

p3_composite_structure.note: Context-only relations are not discriminating properties in 796 and must not be used to repeat the 792 lower-volume/opening test.

competing_alternatives.meaning: The authorized P3 and P4 pixels support a compatible qualitative multi-relation organization for the tested step/junction/platform signature, without directly visible conflict. This is correspondence evidence only, never physical identity.
At least one tested structural relation has a directly visible mutually exclusive state between authorized P3 and P4 pixels. Crop, occlusion or non-observability cannot establish incompatibility.

discriminating_properties.instruction: In each authorized view, determine from visible boundaries whether the step/stair region is LEFT_OF or RIGHT_OF the platform/terrace region. Compare the qualitative relation; category resemblance is not evidence.

In P3, use the authorized step, visible-junction and platform regions to inspect the directly visible termination/junction chain. In P4, inspect only obs_p4_stair and obs_p4_terrace for an observable boundary termination/join configuration. If P4 does not expose such a relation reliably, return NOT_OBSERVABLE for this property; do not invent a junction observation.

In each authorized view, determine whether the stair/step region has a directly visible ABOVE/BELOW qualitative order relative to the platform/terrace region. Return AMBIGUOUS when visible pixels admit multiple orderings and NOT_OBSERVABLE when the relation cannot reliably be inspected.

withheld_memory.rule: Not an authorized LocalObservation. Do not use it or any relation depending on its promotion.

response_invariants: Inspect only authorized photos, observations and exact ROIs; create no LocalObservation.
Every property result tests composite structural correspondence only. Never answer SAME_PHYSICAL_OBJECT, LIKELY_SAME or DISTINCT_PHYSICAL_OBJECTS.
CORRESPONDENCE_COMPATIBLE requires directly visible structural relation evidence in both authorized views; category or shape resemblance is insufficient.
CORRESPONDENCE_INCOMPATIBLE requires a directly visible mutually exclusive tested relation; crop, occlusion, ambiguity or non-observability is insufficient.

AMBIGUOUS and NOT_OBSERVABLE are distinct outcomes: AMBIGUOUS means visible pixels permit multiple interpretations; NOT_OBSERVABLE means the authorized pixels do not reliably expose the tested relation.
Every provenance entry must cite an exact authorized ROI for its observation_refs, plus non-empty pixel_cues and the tested property_token.
Do not repeat the 790 P4/P5 wall-layout discriminant or the 792 P3/P5 lower-volume/opening containment/order discriminant.
The P3 adjacent-wall candidate is WITHHELD and cannot be used as an observation or as support for a relation.
Do not infer metric geometry, camera pose, depth, hidden continuation, complete topology or physical identity.
No response is imported automatically. This request only prepares an external perceptual test.
